scope: Source-only mapping of eight requested families; no implementation or protocol expansion
pinExplanation: References identify the frozen immutable source commit/tree; this mapping makes no deployment claim.

ledger.allSelectedRows: adapter-missing; sourceAdmittedSkills, sourceAdmittedOperations, generalOperations and adapterPaths are empty

findingsFirst: All eleven requested operations have working native tool dispatch entries, but the ledger admits none as a retained source adapter. Existence of a tool/controller is not retained authority.

get_state_bill_status and search_state_floor_votes can spend LegiScan quota and write sync rows/bills after an exact designation misses the stored corpus. Reusing their entire methods as a provider-free retained read would import those side effects.

search_state_bills, get_state_legislator, get_state_rule_status, query_regulatory_dockets and search_intel_articles read global records. They do not themselves receive a delegated principal or produce a resource-authority receipt.

Intel ResearchService and Phase8EvidenceService already own current feature/membership/folder/client-wall checks, source identity and qualified DTOs. Their service-secret native bridge is control-only and accepts tenant/actor in its payload; it is not signed retained principal proof.

search_research_sources combines tenant records, own meetings/mail and own Meri notes. Its optional client resolver checks same-tenant/non-archived visibility, not client-memory-wall authority; unscoped client results and tenant directory notes have no demonstrated per-result wall recheck in this method.

Real context calculations exist for client/citation resolution, news scope/window, personnel default year and private monitor ownership. Frozen retained context receipts and current-use rechecks are missing for these eleven operations; no generic trust or new business policy is inferred.

nativeApi.registration: API AppModule imports MeriModule; MeriModule registers MeriController and a governed MeriToolsService proxy; configureApiHttpApp installs /api prefix.
nativeApi.principal: TenantContextMiddleware authenticates a native request and attaches tenant/user/role context. Class RolesGuard requires standard_user; ToolServiceSecretGuard is an additional production/staging service-identity check. Neither an accepted tool name nor service secret creates retained authority.
nativeApi.payload: executeTool passes the body through attachment/RP-specific admission and request-lifetime control. executeFromAuthenticatedUser normalizes the name and validates side-effecting tools, but these ordinary read inputs use objectInput. objectInput accepts any non-array object or substitutes {}; optionalString trims/truncates; requiredString rejects absence; clampInt coerces finite numbers/numeric strings. Advertised Anthropic object schemas are not a closed runtime read-body parser for these families.
nativeApi.governedProxy: The registered proxy adds chart ownership checks, memory-control presentation and federal-market dispatch. For the mapped methods it delegates to the raw service; it does not add a generic per-result client-wall or signed context receipt.
nativeApi.lifetime: withMeriToolRequestControl/assertMeriToolRequestActive guard native request lifetime. The LegiWatch fetch carries its abort signal. These controls are not a retained identity/resource correlation contract.

intelBridge.registration: Intel bootstrap /intel-api prefix; AppModule imports TrackerModule; TrackerModule registers KeywordMeriController, ResearchController, Phase8Controller and their canonical providers.
intelBridge.caller: MeriToolsService.legiwatchTool requires configured INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET and ctx.clerkUserId, resolves optional clientId via ensureClientVisible and sends {tenantId, actor:ctx.clerkUserId, tool, input:{...input,clientId}} using x-internal-service-secret.
intelBridge.receiver: WorkflowSourceGuard compares the service secret. KeywordMeriController.route uses permissive object coercion, requires a nonempty actor string <=200 and tenantId matching /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i, constructs {tenantId,clerkUserId:actor,role:null}, dispatches a fixed tool list and rejects read/apply mismatch. It does not verify a signed retained actor envelope.
intelBridge.errorBehavior: Missing bridge secret/clerk subject ->502; any non-OK Intel HTTP response becomes Core400 with the HTTP status in a review message. Do not assume native HTTP status preservation across this bridge.
intelBridge.nativeUiAlternative: Intel ResearchController and Phase8Controller use native TenantGuard plus FolderTrackerGuard. These bearer controls are separate from the internal service-secret route and from retained proof.

intelCurrentOwners.membershipFeature: ReportService.authorize checks the requested feature flag and FolderSourceDataRepository.activeMember using tenant_memberships joined to users by ctx.clerkUserId and status active.
intelCurrentOwners.actorScope: FolderTrackerService.withActor uses a tenant transaction and app.folder_actor/app.folder_admin; folder() reads the tenant folder. Explicit write checks are separate; read access also depends on the existing database policies and actor transaction, not an invented owner-only read policy.
intelCurrentOwners.clientWall: KeywordRuleService.folder checks a folder-linked non-archived client against active membership and client_memory_access when memory_wall. ResearchService.context repeats the current client check for explicit clientId and rejects folder/client mismatch. Phase8EvidenceService.context additionally replaces null clientId with the actual folder client before ResearchService.context.
intelCurrentOwners.retainedGap: These are real current business owners, but their existing methods do not emit a closed identity/resource revision envelope for these new retained operations or perform the retained before/after correlation protocol. Native feature/member/wall checks cannot be relabeled ALL3 proof.

currentAll3.disposition: The frozen shared retained data codec accepts exactly these three operations. None of the eleven mapped operations is in that set. This artifact adds no generic tool route, allowlist entry, codec operation, recipient, trust provider or retained adapter.

families.contextDisposition: No ledger context keys declared; this does not waive current retained principal, exact request, source-revision or expiry correlation.

sharedResolution.behavior: Normalize/validate canonical stateBillKey first. Otherwise parse designation with optional state hint; require a state; stored candidates match parsed state/billNumber and choose most recently syncedAt take1. If none, call lookupStateBillLive. Invalid or absent resolution returns an explicit note.
sharedResolution.sideEffectBoundary: The live helper requires a configured key, reserves four shared monthly quota units under advisory lock, upserts/updates state_sync_cursor, calls LegiScan session/masterlist/bill APIs and normalizes/upserts state bill rows. It caches misses for one hour. Do not invoke this fallback in provider-free qualification or silently call it a pure read.
